rationale.edition: Every changed path in changed_files.txt lives under web/src/** (open-source frontend) plus scripts/translations/*.json, and none are in enterprise-owned locations (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ paths). No enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in any changed path or symbol, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is user-facing (a dashboard editing/save flow in web/src), there is no explicit opt-out (feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty, no tests-added label), and the diff is not docs/CI/comment-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because this introduces a new user-exercisable save-conflict dialog: on a 409 save conflict the user must choose compare/merge/discard/overwrite, with a new dialog-stacking layer so the conflict dialog renders above open overlays. That decision flow and its dialog behavior need verification.
rationale.area: The bulk of UI changes live under web/src/components/dashboards/, web/src/views/Dashboards/, web/src/composables/dashboard/, and web/src/utils/dashboard/, so this is a Dashboards feature. Sibling E2E specs for dashboards live in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/ (the matrix's actual_folder for dashboard shards).
rationale.group: Dashboards-Core is the closest matrix shard: it holds the general dashboard behaviors (dashboard.spec.js, dashboard2.spec.js, dashboards-form-validation.spec.js, etc.), and a save-conflict resolution flow is a core dashboard editing/saving behavior rather than a charts/tables/variables/settings-specific one.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The changed *.spec.ts files are all Vitest unit tests under web/src/** (e.g. useDashboardSaveConflict.spec.ts, saveConflict.spec.ts, dialogStacking.spec.ts) and do not live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so they do not count as E2E coverage.
